fluff.overview:
Taurian infantry reflect the Concordat's citizen-soldier tradition, with national service requirements ensuring that most adults have received basic military training before ever donning a uniform. Mechanized wheeled platoons offer a balance of speed and economy, their wheeled transports being cheaper to maintain than hover or tracked alternatives. For a military that must stretch limited resources across a significant number of garrison worlds, this cost efficiency matters as much as tactical performance.

Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
